high_level_description: Avant-garde editorial portrait in an overgrown greenhouse: a woman stands far to the right edge of a wide-angle frame, close to the fogged glass, while a wall of monstera and palm leaves fills the vast left side with teal-green shadow. One continuous camera exposure filling the full image area.

style_description.aesthetics: avant-garde fashion editorial, deliberate off-center negative space, chiaroscuro restraint, 90s art-house film mood, no text
style_description.lighting: teal-green daylight filtering through dense leaves, casting a dappled lattice of sharp leaf shadows across her face and dress; deep green-black shadow elsewhere; one thin warm rim of late sun on her cheekbone
style_description.photo: ultra wide-angle plastic toy-camera lens, slight chromatic aberration fringing magenta-green at the frame edges, gentle barrel softness in the corners, visible film grain, natural skin texture with pores
style_description.film_emulation: expired Fuji Superia 400 through a plastic toy lens

compositional_deconstruction.background: A floor-to-ceiling greenhouse wall: slender white steel glazing bars forming a visible criss-cross grid of glass panes, fogged with humidity, overgrown with monstera leaves pressing against the glass; the left two-thirds of the frame is leaf shadow and negative space.

elements.desc: The woman from mid-thigh up at the right edge of frame, three-quarter profile, dark slicked hair, bias-cut sage slip dress, eyes closed toward the light, dappled leaf shadows patterning her skin.

atmosphere: humid greenhouse haze, dust and pollen motes visible in the teal light shafts
